figurative_meaning_en: the progression or inexorable flow of time
example_sentences_in_bangla: জীবন কালস্রোতে ভেসে যায়, কেউ তা থামাতে পারে না।
example_sentences_in_english: Life floats away in the current of time, no one can stop it.
The beauty of youth also dissolves in the flow of time.
history: This idiom is famously used by Rabindranath Tagore in his works, such as in the line 'কালস্রোতে ভেসে যায় জীবন, যৌবন ধনমান', highlighting the transient nature of life in Bengali literature.
note: Often evokes a sense of inevitability and melancholy in Bengali poetic expression.
